description: Defines the ResolvedTargetDeps class used for efficiently managing and iterating over dependencies of a Target in a build system, including methods for accessing different dependency subsets and internal memory management.

classes.name: ResolvedTargetDeps
classes.description: A class to record and access dependencies of a Target efficiently, providing spans over public, private, data, linked, and all dependencies.

methods.name: ResolvedTargetDeps
methods.description: Default constructor and parameterized constructor initializing dependency counts and allocating dependency pointers.

methods.name: public_deps
methods.description: Returns a span over public dependencies.

methods.name: private_deps
methods.description: Returns a span over private dependencies.

methods.name: data_deps
methods.description: Returns a span over data dependencies.

methods.name: linked_deps
methods.description: Returns a span over linked dependencies (public + private).

methods.name: all_deps
methods.description: Returns a span over all dependencies.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Static method to allocate and populate an array of dependency pointers from dependency vectors.
